GUIDE

Questions & answers

Local operation, data boundaries, filing compliance, pricing and delivery: how an engagement works.

Where does the assistant run?

On a computer or workstation you choose. Your data stays on your device and network. Remote support, if needed, happens only with your temporary authorization and is logged.

Will the AI send emails or change documents on its own?

No. External actions start as drafts and only go out after your approval. Missing or uncertain information is flagged, never guessed.

Which model do you use, and whose account?

We work with mainstream desktop agent runtimes. You bring your own model account, so usage and cost stay visible and under your control.

Do you file ISF or customs entries for us?

No. ISF and entry filing must go through licensed customs brokers and ABI/ACE (per U.S. CBP). We draft, check and watch deadlines.

What hardware do we need?

An ordinary office computer or workstation. No server room required. Exact requirements follow the task assessment.

How does pricing work?

One-time setup plus annual maintenance. No per-seat subscription. Pilot engagements are available; we quote after understanding the task and its acceptance criteria.

What happens when something goes wrong?

Every deployment keeps run logs and review records, and issues are fixed as a priority. Support terms are agreed in scope.

How is this different from SaaS tools?

Your data stays local, there is no subscription, and the workflow is shaped around your SOP.

How long does it take to go live?

After agreed sample verification, deployment typically takes about two weeks, excluding a shadow-running period. Final timing depends on the task assessment.

Who are you?

HarnessLoop is run as a one-person company (OPC), so you work directly with the person who runs it. We suggest starting with one concrete task: contact@harnessloop.ai.
